title: SMH Hits Key Fib Level: AAPL Record Highs & Chart Setups
speaker: Drew Dosek

macro_themes.view: Fed's Williams signalling one more hike this year and none in 2027 paints a rosy picture for now.
Capital is rotating from AI hardware (memory, storage) into safer Mag 7 names like Apple.
Attacks on Saudi supply mean oil is more likely to rise while the conflict continues.

calls.condition: As long as price holds above the inverse head-and-shoulders neckline, the measured move to 800.92 is on the table
calls.reason: Flat day reads as bullish consolidation: an inverse head and shoulders plus a bull flag stacked at the top of the chart.
calls.quote: this targeted measured move is on the table up at $800.92 anticipating the S&P 500 to hit that 8,000 mark

calls.condition: If the S&P pushes higher, the Nasdaq likely crosses 28,000; further selling should bounce off the 26,900 trendline
calls.reason: Holding its breakout above the prior all-time high and the declining trendline; rising March trendline has produced bounces each time.
calls.quote: we likely we sell will see the Nasdaq crossover the 28,000 point mark.

calls.condition: Would feel better about the bounce had the 573 gap filled
calls.reason: Six down days into the 0.618 fib, which aligned with prior pivots; strong bounce suggests a near-term bottom, with the channel bottom as a speed bump.
calls.quote: it looks like we at least put in a near term bottom in the SMH.

calls.reason: Inside-bar bearish consolidation and a weekly topping tail imply more downside, though the hourly chart is consolidating bullishly.
calls.quote: it still has uh this weekly topping tail intact. That all implies a larger time frame, implies more downside

calls.condition: If 4,100 support breaks, next support 3,900 then the 3,886 pivot zone
calls.reason: Still in bearish consolidation under pressure from rising yields.
calls.quote: Still in bearish consolidation. Should this support level of $4,100 break, the next level is going to be this low pivot at $3,900.

calls.condition: If the 50% channel line (~59.15) breaks, the H&S measured move targets 53.26; buys physical under 53 to 50, more at 40 and 30
calls.reason: Repeatedly knocking on the 50% line of a channel dating to 2008; daily head and shoulders targets 53.26, but long run he expects silver back to highs or much higher.
calls.quote: I will be a buyer of physical silver under $53 all the way down here to 50.

calls.condition: Want price back above 85,000-85,500; the longer it sits near 80,500 the more likely support breaks
calls.reason: Holding key trendline at 80,500 but sitting in a near-term daily bear flag.
calls.quote: All in all, nothing's wrong with Bitcoin, but the more and more it hangs out down here, the more and more likely that it starts sliding

calls.condition: As long as Middle East conflict continues
calls.reason: Bottoming-tail-like candle at 86.90 support followed by a straight rally; attacks on Saudi supply.
calls.quote: as long as there's conflict still going on, uh I see more likelihood oil could go up higher.

calls.condition: May retrace first; starts buying around 3.30-3.32
calls.reason: Breakout above the declining trendline; measured move back into the long-term parallel channel targets 3.89, though price looks extended.
calls.quote: I do see that eventually getting back into the parallel and setting up for an attempt up here to $3.89.

calls.condition: If it gets a daily close above 344.57, it could push to 365-370; would only buy a pullback to ~333.49 or a bigger market dip
calls.reason: New all-time high on rotation from chips into a safer Mag 7 name; future AI servers and on-device LLM Macs support further upside.
calls.quote: Apple could be pushing up into the 365 to 370 range, which is up here on the top of the parallel.

calls.condition: Expects a near-term bounce into ~860 then rejection and a fade to the untested 0.618 fib
calls.reason: Bounced off the $700 round number after a breakdown from its parallel; a retest of 860 should get rejected, and Toshiba competition is a headwind.
calls.quote: I still though anticipate more downside with XTX after a little bit of near-term upside right into X marks the spot and a rejection

calls.condition: As long as price does not close below the inverse H&S neckline, measured move target 217.98; near-term bounce likely capped near 170
calls.reason: Retrace into the inverse head-and-shoulders neckline plus pivot trendline support makes it a potential buy zone.
calls.quote: looking like it's getting into the buy zone for a safe potential long as long as price maintains above that neckline

calls.condition: Clear 195-200 and it likely makes a beeline to retest the broken parallel channel
calls.reason: Second bounce attempt after rejecting from a broken channel; AI data-center power demand helps, though it is pricier and lower output.
calls.quote: I see a scenario where we could be attacking $200 in the near term.

calls.condition: Bulls need a move above 146.94, then 162.82
calls.reason: Repeatedly hitting the bottom of a parallel channel after a failed retrace, so more likely to break lower than rise.
calls.quote: So we're at a point of potential breaking lower rather than rising higher.

notes: No date stated; recorded the day before CPI ('CPI tomorrow'), i.e. likely 2026-10-13 if CPI was Wed 10-14, so listing date may be a day late. SPY target 800.92 is in SPY units. SpaceX ticker not stated; recorded as 'SPACEX'. 'XTX' in transcript read as STX. AAPL medium target 367.5 is the midpoint of his 365-370 range.
